summary: Recommends testing changes in staging first, using group variables for environment differences and --syntax-check to catch syntax errors.
questions: How do I check a playbook for syntax errors without running it?
Does my staging environment need to be the same size as production?

answer_card.title: Try changes in staging first
answer_card.answer_md:
Test changes in staging before production. Environments don't need to be the same size; use group variables to handle differences. Check syntax with:

```shell
ansible-playbook --syntax-check playbook.yml
```
